edits.before: - Bard Cosmic Binding: matchup-defining — The wall-stun starts every Bard pick — never hug terrain near him. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
